hypotheses.justification: Split into N = 0 and N ≠ 0, retaining the existing proof in the latter case. At zero, Nat.primeFactors_zero makes both products equal 1, so it suffices to prove (Gamma0 0).index = 0. By mem_Gamma0_iff_dvd, Gamma0 0 consists of matrices with lower-left entry zero. The matrices L(n) = !![1, 0; n, 1], for n : ℤ, have distinct cosets: QuotientGroup.eq reduces equality to L(m)⁻¹ * L(n) ∈ Gamma0 0, whose lower-left entry is n - m, forcing n = m. Thus the quotient is infinite, and Subgroup.index_eq_zero_iff_infinite gives index zero. Hence the excluded case also satisfies the unchanged conclusion.
